Both live in CONCEPT_LESSONS already.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nconst CONJUNCT_PATH_DEFS: DiacriticPathDef[] = [\n  { pathSlug: \"conjunct-pairin-rara\", curriculumSlug: \"pairin-rara\" },\n  // Subscript ਹ + final ਹ both fall under haha-tone in the source data\n  // (the book conflates them — both raise the tone of the syllable).\n  { pathSlug: \"conjunct-pairin-haha\", curriculumSlug: \"haha-tone\" },\n];\n\nfunction buildConjunctLessons(): Record<string, PathLesson> {\n  const out: Record<string, PathLesson> = {};\n  CONJUNCT_PATH_DEFS.forEach((def, i) => {\n    const entry = CONCEPT_LESSONS.find((c) => c.slug === def.curriculumSlug);\n    if (!entry) return;\n    const newWords = entry.examples.slice(0, 4).map((e) => ({ pa: e.pa, en: e.en }));\n\n    const reviewWords: { pa: string; en: string }[] = [];\n    if (i > 0) {\n      const cursors = CONJUNCT_PATH_DEFS.slice(0, i).map(() => 0);\n      while (reviewWords.length < Math.min(i, 3)) {\n        let advanced = false;\n        for (let li = 0; li < i; li++) {\n          if (reviewWords.length >= 3) break;\n          const pos = cursors[li];\n          const prior = CONCEPT_LESSONS.find((c) => c.slug === CONJUNCT_PATH_DEFS[li].curriculumSlug);\n          const candidates = prior?.examples ?? [];\n          if (pos < candidates.length) {\n            reviewWords.push({ pa: candidates[pos].pa, en: candidates[pos].en });\n            cursors[li]++;\n            advanced = true;\n          }\n        }\n        if (!advanced) break;\n      }\n    }\n\n    out[def.pathSlug] = {\n      id: def.pathSlug,\n      sectionId: \"s12\",\n      kind: \"teach-and-test\",\n      title: `${entry.name_pa} ${entry.symbol}`,\n      // Reuse the diacritic-* convention so the page resolver finds it\n      // via the existing DiacriticTeachContent component (conjuncts and\n      // diacritics share the \"symbol + name + explainer + words\" shape).\n      curriculumRef: `diacritic-${def.curriculumSlug}`,\n      exercises: diacriticLessonExercises(newWords, reviewWords, def.pathSlug),\n    };\n  });\n\n  const checkExercises: Exercise[] = [];\n  const allWords = CONJUNCT_PATH_DEFS.flatMap((d) => {\n    const entry = CONCEPT_LESSONS.find((c) => c.slug === d.curriculumSlug);\n    return (entry?.examples.slice(0, 4) ?? []).map((e) => ({ pa: e.pa, en: e.en }));\n  });\n  const wordPool = allWords.map((w) => w.pa);\n  const meaningPool = allWords.map((w) => w.en);\n  CONJUNCT_PATH_DEFS.forEach((def) => {\n    const entry = CONCEPT_LESSONS.find((c) => c.slug === def.curriculumSlug);\n    const w = entry?.examples[0];\n    if (!w) return;\n    const apwId = `check-conjuncts-${w.pa}-apw`;\n    const wpmId = `check-conjuncts-${w.pa}-wpm`;\n    checkExercises.push({\n      id: apwId,\n      kind: \"audio-pick-word\",\n      audioForWord: w.pa,\n      options: [w.pa, ...distractorsFromPool(w.pa, wordPool, apwId, 3)],\n    });\n    checkExercises.push({\n      id: wpmId,\n      kind: \"word-pick-meaning\",\n      word: w.pa,\n      correctMeaning: w.en,\n      distractorMeanings: distractorsFromPool(w.en, meaningPool, wpmId, 3),\n    });\n  });\n\n  out[\"check-conjuncts\"] = {\n    id: \"check-conjuncts\",\n    sectionId: \"s12\",\n    kind: \"check\",\n    title: \"Conjuncts check\",\n    exercises: checkExercises,\n  };\n\n  return out;\n}\n\nexport const PATH_LESSONS: Record<string, PathLesson> = {\n  ...buildLetterLessons(),\n  ...buildMuktaLessons(),\n  ...buildMatraLessons(),\n  ...buildDiacriticLessons(),\n  ...buildConjunctLessons(),\n};"
}

h.sign : \"·\"}\n                <div className=\"text-[10px] opacity-70\">{h.iso}</div>\n              </div>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n\n          {rows.map((row) => (\n            <div\n              key={row.consonant}\n              className=\"mt-1 grid gap-1\"\n              style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `minmax(40px,auto) repeat(${row.forms.length}, minmax(48px, 1fr))` }}\n            >\n              <div className=\"flex items-center justify-center font-serif text-lg text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300\">\n                {row.consonant}\n              </div>\n              {row.forms.map((cell, i) => (\n                <button\n                  key={i}\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  // Reuse AudioButton-style play via an inline AudioButton —\n                  // each cell is itself a small play target.\n                  className=\"cursor-default border-0 bg-transparent p-0 text-inherit\"\n                  aria-label={`Play ${cell.display}`}\n                >\n                  <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900\">\n                    <AudioButton word={cell.display} size=\"sm\" label={`Play ${cell.display}`} />\n                    <div className=\"mt-1 font-serif text-base text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50\">\n                      {cell.display}\n                    </div>\n                  </div>\n                </button>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"

Each lesson covers\n// one line of consonants from LINES_DATA; for each consonant we\n// generate the 10 muharni forms (mukta + 9 matras) and test\n// recognition through audio-pick + visual exercises.\n//\n// muharni-1 wraps the line-1 letters but only ਸ and ਹ get full\n// rotations — the vowel carriers ੳ ਅ ੲ don't combine the same way\n// (they ARE the vowels), so they're called out in a teach-screen note.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// 10 canonical muharni columns: mukta + 9 matras in PME order.\nexport const MUHARNI_MATRAS: readonly { sign: string; iso: string; name: string }[] = [\n  { sign: \"\",  iso: \"ə\", name: \"mukta\" },\n  { sign: \"ਾ\", iso: \"ā\", name: \"kanna\" },\n  { sign: \"ਿ\", iso: \"i\", name: \"sihari\" },\n  { sign: \"ੀ\", iso: \"ī\", name: \"bihari\" },\n  { sign: \"ੁ\", iso: \"u\", name: \"aunkar\" },\n  { sign: \"ੂ\", iso: \"ū\", name: \"dulænkar\" },\n  { sign: \"ੇ\", iso: \"e\", name: \"lavan\" },\n  { sign: \"ੈ\", iso: \"æ\", name: \"dulavan\" },\n  { sign: \"ੋ\", iso: \"o\", name: \"hora\" },\n  { sign: \"ੌ\", iso: \"ɔ\", name: \"kanaura\" },\n];\n\ninterface MuharniPathDef {\n  pathSlug: string;\n  lineNum: number;\n  // Subset of the line's letters that get full muharni rotations. For\n  // line 1 this is just ਸ and ਹ (the vowel carriers ੳ ਅ ੲ are handled\n  // via the vowelCarriersNote prop on the teach screen instead).\n  consonants: string[];\n  vowelCarriersNote?: string;\n}\n\nconst MUHARNI_PATH_DEFS: MuharniPathDef[] = [\n  {\n    pathSlug: \"muharni-1\",\n    lineNum: 1,\n    consonants: [\"ਸ\", \"ਹ\"],\n    vowelCarriersNote:\n      \"ੳ ਅ ੲ are vowel carriers, not consonants — they ARE the vowels themselves, so they don't get a muharni rotation. You'll meet their forms (ਉ ਊ ਓ ਅ ਆ ਐ ਔ ਇ ਈ ਏ) as they appear in real words.\",\n  },\n  { pathSlug: \"muharni-2\", lineNum: 2, consonants: [\"ਕ\", \"ਖ\", \"ਗ\", \"ਘ\", \"ਙ\"] },\n  { pathSlug: \"muharni-3\", lineNum: 3, consonants: [\"ਚ\", \"ਛ\", \"ਜ\", \"ਝ\", \"ਞ\"] },\n  { pathSlug: \"muharni-4\", lineNum: 4, consonants: [\"ਟ\", \"ਠ\", \"ਡ\", \"ਢ\", \"ਣ\"] },\n  { pathSlug: \"muharni-5\", lineNum: 5, consonants: [\"ਤ\", \"ਥ\", \"ਦ\", \"ਧ\", \"ਨ\"] },\n  { pathSlug: \"muharni-6\", lineNum: 6, consonants: [\"ਪ\", \"ਫ\", \"ਬ\", \"ਭ\", \"ਮ\"] },\n  { pathSlug: \"muharni-7\", lineNum: 7, consonants: [\"ਯ\", \"ਰ\", \"ਲ\", \"ਵ\", \"ੜ\"] },\n];\n\n/** All CV combinations for a single consonant: 10 strings, mukta first. */\nexport function muharniFormsFor(consonant: string): string[] {\n  return MUHARNI_MATRAS.map((m) => consonant + m.sign);\n}\n\n/**\n * Per-lesson exercise mix. For each consonant, pick a 3-form sample to\n * drill: 2 audio-pick-letter (hear CV, pick the right one from 4\n * options) and 1 letter-pick-audio (see CV, pick matching audio).\n * Distractor pool = all CV forms across this lesson's consonants.\n */\nfunction muharniLessonExercises(consonants: string[], slug: string): Exercise[] {\n  const allLessonForms = consonants.flatMap((c) => muharniFormsFor(c));\n  // Stable per-consonant sample so the same form picks survive regen.\n  const sampleIndices = [1, 3, 6]; // kanna, bihari, lavan — covers short/long, above/below\n  const out: Exercise[] = [];\n  consonants.forEach((c) => {\n    const forms = muharniFormsFor(c);\n    sampleIndices.forEach((idx, j) => {\n      const target = forms[idx];\n      const useAudio = j % 2 === 0;\n      const id = useAudio\n        ? `${slug}-${c}-${idx}-a`\n        : `${slug}-${c}-${idx}-v`;\n      const options = [\n        target,\n        ...distractorsFromPool(target, allLessonForms, id, 3),\n      ];\n      out.push(useAudio\n        ? { id, kind: \"audio-pick-letter\", audioForLetter: target, options }\n        : { id, kind: \"letter-pick-audio\", displayLetter: target, audioOptions: options });\n    });\n  });\n  return out;\n}\n\nfunction buildMuharniLessons(): Record<string, PathLesson> {\n  const out: Record<string, PathLesson> = {};\n  MUHARNI_PATH_DEFS.forEach((def) => {\n    out[def.pathSlug] = {\n      id: def.pathSlug,\n      sectionId: \"s13\",\n      kind: \"teach-and-test\",\n      title: `Muharni — line ${def.lineNum}`,\n      curriculumRef: `muharni-${def.pathSlug.replace(\"muharni-\", \"\")}`,\n      exercises: muharniLessonExercises(def.consonants, def.pathSlug),\n    };\n  });\n\n  // Closing check: 1 audio-pick + 1 visual-pick per consonant across\n  // every line — same sample form (bihari ੀ, the most distinctive long-i).\n  const allConsonants = MUHARNI_PATH_DEFS.flatMap((d) => d.consonants);\n  const allForms = allConsonants.flatMap((c) => muharniFormsFor(c));\n  const checkExercises: Exercise[] = [];\n  allConsonants.forEach((c) => {\n    const target = muharniFormsFor(c)[3]; // bihari\n    const apickId = `check-muharni-${c}-a`;\n    const vpickId = `check-muharni-${c}-v`;\n    checkExercises.push({\n      id: apickId,\n      kind: \"audio-pick-letter\",\n      audioForLetter: target,\n      options: [target, ...distractorsFromPool(target, allForms, apickId, 3)],\n    });\n    checkExercises.push({\n      id: vpickId,\n      kind: \"letter-pick-audio\",\n      displayLetter: target,\n      audioOptions: [target, ...distractorsFromPool(target, allForms, vpickId, 3)],\n    });\n  });\n  out[\"check-muharni\"] = {\n    id: \"check-muharni\",\n    sectionId: \"s13\",\n    kind: \"check\",\n    title: \"Muharni check\",\n    exercises: checkExercises,\n  };\n\n  return out;\n}\n\n// Re-export defs + the matra table for the teach screen + debug page.\nexport { MUHARNI_PATH_DEFS };\n\nexport const PATH_LESSONS: Record<string, PathLesson> = {\n  ...buildLetterLessons(),\n  ...buildMuktaLessons(),\n  ...buildMatraLessons(),\n  ...buildDiacriticLessons(),\n  ...buildConjunctLessons(),\n  ...buildMuharniLessons(),\n};"
}

  "content": "\"use client\";\n\n// Teach screen for sentence-reading lessons. Each card shows one\n// Punjabi sentence with an audio button + its English translation. Tap\n// any word inside the sentence to hear that word in isolation — gives\n// the learner a way to scan/zoom into a sentence before re-listening\n// to the whole thing. Used by §9 mukta-reading first, will be reused\n// by §14 sentence reading and later sakhi readers.\n\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\nimport AudioButton from \"./AudioButton\";\n\nexport interface ReadingSentence {\n  pa: string;             // full sentence including danda\n  en: string;             // single-line gloss\n  // Optional pre-segmented word list for tap-to-hear. Falls back to a\n  // simple whitespace split if absent.\n  words?: { pa: string; en?: string }[];\n}\n\nexport function SentenceReadingContent({\n  intro,\n  sentences,\n  footnote,\n}: {\n  intro?: string;\n  sentences: ReadingSentence[];\n  footnote?: string;\n}) {\n  return (\n    <div className=\"space-y-5\">\n      {intro && (\n        <p className=\"text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400\">{intro}</p>\n      )}\n      <ul className=\"space-y-3\">\n        {sentences.map((s, i) => (\n          <SentenceCard key={i} sentence={s} />\n        ))}\n      </ul>\n      {footnote && (\n        <p className=\"rounded-md bg-blue-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-blue-900 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-blue-200\">\n          {footnote}\n        </p>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction SentenceCard({ sentence }: { sentence: ReadingSentence }) {\n  const [activeWord, setActiveWord] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const words = sentence.words ?? splitOnWhitespace(sentence.pa);\n\n  return (\n    <li className=\"rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-start gap-3\">\n        <AudioButton word={sentence.pa} size=\"md\" label=\"Play sentence\" />\n        <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-2\">\n          <div className=\"font-serif text-xl leading-relaxed text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50\">\n            {words.map((w, i) => (\n              <button\n                key={i}\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => setActiveWord((cur) => (cur === w.pa ? null : w.pa))}\n                className={\n                  \"rounded px-1 transition \" +\n                  (activeWord === w.pa\n                    ? \"bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950\"\n                    : \"hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900\")\n                }\n              >\n                {w.pa}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400\">\n            {sentence.en}\n          </div>\n          {activeWord && (\n            <ActiveWordRow word={activeWord} words={words} />\n          )}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </li>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction ActiveWordRow({\n  word,\n  words,\n}: {\n  word: string;\n  words: { pa: string; en?: string }[];\n}) {\n  const gloss = words.find((w) => w.pa === word)?.en;\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm dark:bg-zinc-900\">\n      <AudioButton word={word} size=\"sm\" label={`Play ${word}`} />\n      <span className=\"font-serif text-lg text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50\">{word}</span>\n      {gloss && <span className=\"text-zinc-500\">— {gloss}</span>}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\n// Lightweight tokenizer used when a sentence doesn't carry an explicit\n// word-list — splits on whitespace and strips the trailing danda from\n// each piece. Good enough for short sentences; richer sakhi readers\n// will use morpheme-aware breakdowns.\nfunction splitOnWhitespace(text: string): { pa: string }[] {\n  return text\n    .replace(/।/g, \" ।\") // detach danda so it doesn't join the last word\n    .split(/\\s+/)\n    .filter((w) => w && w !== \"।\")\n    .map((pa) => ({ pa }));\n}\n"
}

> AGENT

Two issues, both real:

**(1)** The RLS error on verify — `upsert` does INSERT-or-UPDATE-on-conflict, but the table only has INSERT/DELETE policies. When you click verify on a clip that was already verified (e.g. you verified it in a different section), Postgres rejects the implicit UPDATE.

**(2)** Overlapping sounds — same audio key showing in multiple sections (a word can be both a letter example and a matra example).

Fixing both: add an UPDATE policy + dedupe display globally so each audio appears only once.

1	// Type definitions for the v1.1 course layer.
2	//
3	// The course is a sequence of PATH_SECTIONS, each containing an ordered
4	// list of PathLessons. A lesson has a "teach" screen (which can reuse
5	// existing content from data/curriculum.ts via curriculumRef) and a
6	// set of mastery exercises.
7	//
8	// Exercises are a discriminated union — each kind has its own shape, so
9	// the runner can switch on `kind` to render the right UI without runtime
10	// type checks. Adding a new exercise kind = add to the union + add a
11	// renderer + add a checker.
12	//
13	// Lesson IDs are slugs (e.g. "letter-ooraa") used as primary keys in
14	// lesson_progress / exercise_results tables. They MUST be stable across
15	// deploys — changing a slug breaks every user's progress against that
16	// lesson. Pick once, never rename.
17	
18	export type ExerciseKind =
19	  | "audio-pick-letter"
20	  | "letter-pick-audio"
21	  | "type-romanization"
22	  | "match-pairs"
23	  | "tap-in-order"
24	  // Word-reading kinds, used by §9+ (mukta words, sentences, etc.)
25	  | "word-pick-meaning"
26	  | "meaning-pick-word"
27	  | "audio-pick-word";
28	
29	interface ExerciseBase {
30	  id: string;
31	  kind: ExerciseKind;
32	}
33	
34	// User hears audio for one letter, must pick it from N options.
35	export interface AudioPickLetterExercise extends ExerciseBase {
36	  kind: "audio-pick-letter";
37	  audioForLetter: string;   // the correct letter, whose audio plays
38	  options: string[];        // N letters to choose from (must include the answer)
39	}
40	
41	// User sees a letter, must tap which of N audio buttons matches.
42	export interface LetterPickAudioExercise extends ExerciseBase {

25	// Stable shuffle keyed off the exercise id so the option order doesn't
26	// reshuffle on every re-render but does vary between exercises.
27	function seededShuffle<T>(arr: T[], seed: string): T[] {
28	  const out = [...arr];
29	  let h = 0;
30	  for (let i = 0; i < seed.length; i++) h = (h * 31 + seed.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
31	  for (let i = out.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
32	    h = (h * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
33	    const j = h % (i + 1);
34	    [out[i], out[j]] = [out[j], out[i]];
35	  }
36	  return out;
37	}
38	
39	// audioWordForLetter (imported above) returns the TTS prompt for a letter,
40	// applying any per-letter overrides for cases where Chirp mishandles the
41	// canonical name. Defined centrally in lib/course/letter-lookup.ts so all
42	// audio surfaces stay consistent.
43	
44	interface ExerciseShellProps {
45	  prompt: React.ReactNode;
46	  children: React.ReactNode;
47	}
48	
49	function ExerciseShell({ prompt, children }: ExerciseShellProps) {
50	  return (
51	    <div className="space-y-6">
52	      <div className="text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{prompt}</div>
53	      {children}
54	    </div>
55	  );
56	}

const next = [...cur];\n      const firstEmpty = next.indexOf(null);\n      if (firstEmpty < 0) return next;\n      next[firstEmpty] = bankIdx;\n      return next;\n    });\n  }\n  function       : \"border-zinc-300 text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700\")\n                }\n              >\n                {filledBy[i] !== null ? bank[filledBy[i]!] : \"____\"}\n              </button>\n            )}\n          </span>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n\n      <ChipBank chips={bank} taken={taken} onPick={placeNext} />\n\n      <div className=\"flex justify-end\">\n        <button\n          type=\"button\"\n          disabled={!allFilled}\n          onClick={check}\n          className=\"rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-6 py-2.5 font-medium text-white hover:bg-zinc-700 disabled:opacity-40 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200\"\n        >\n          Check\n        </button>\n      </div>\n    </ExerciseShell>\n  );\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 10. Assemble translation — English shown, tap Punjabi chips to build\n// the corresponding Punjabi sentence.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport function AssembleTranslationRenderer({\n  exercise,\n  onSubmit,\n}: {\n  exercise: import(\"@/lib/course/types\").AssembleTranslationExercise;\n  onSubmit: (wasCorrect: boolean) => void;\n}) {\n  const bank = useMemo(() => seededShuffle(exercise.bank, exercise.id), [exercise.id, exercise.bank]);\n  // Ordered list of bank indices the learner has tapped.\n  const [picks, setPicks] = useState<number[]>([]);\n  const taken = new Set<number>(picks);\n\n  function place(bankIdx: number) {\n    if (taken.has(bankIdx)) return;\n    setPicks((cur) => [...cur, bankIdx]);\n  }\n  function unplaceAt(seqIdx: number) {\n    setPicks((cur) => cur.filter((_, i) => i !== seqIdx));\n  }\n  function check() {\n    const built = picks.map((i) => bank[i]);\n    const ok =\n      built.length === exercise.correctOrder.length &&\n      built.every((w, i) => w === exercise.correctOrder[i]);\n    onSubmit(ok);\n  }\n\n  const allLengthMatches = picks.length === exercise.correctOrder.length;\n\n  return (\n    <ExerciseShell prompt=\"Translate the sentence by tapping the words in order.\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950\">\n        <AudioButton\n          word={exercise.audioForSentence}\n          size=\"md\"\n          label=\"Play the sentence\"\n        />\n        <div className=\"flex-1 text-lg text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50\">\n          {exercise.englishPrompt}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Built sequence — top track */}\n      <div className=\"min-h-[3.5rem] rounded-lg border-2 border-zinc-300 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950\">\n        {picks.length === 0 ? (\n          <div className=\"text-center text-sm text-zinc-400\">\n            Tap chips below to build the translation\n          </div>\n        ) : (\n          <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2\">\n            {picks.map((bankIdx, i) => (\n              <button\n                key={`${bankIdx}-${i}`}\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => unplaceAt(i)}\n                className=\"rounded-lg border-2 border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 font-serif text-xl text-emerald-900 dark:border-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-100\"\n              >\n                {bank[bankIdx]}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n\n      <ChipBank chips={bank} taken={taken} onPick={place} />\n\n      <div className=\"flex justify-end\">\n        <button\n          type=\"button\"\n          disabled={!allLengthMatches}\n          onClick={check}\n          className=\"rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-6 py-2.5 font-medium text-white hover:bg-zinc-700 disabled:opacity-40 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200\"\n        >\n          Check\n        </button>\n      </div>\n    </ExerciseShell>\n  );\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 8. Audio → tap the word (variant of audio-pick-letter for whole words)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------"
}

35	// Lifecycle:
36	//   teach
37	//     ↓
38	//   main-exercise → main-feedback ⇌  (advance on correct | re-enqueue on wrong)
39	//     ↓ (main queue exhausted)
40	//   review-exercise → review-feedback ⇌ (advance on correct | re-enqueue on wrong)
41	//     ↓ (review queue exhausted, or none to review)
42	//   completed
43	//
44	// "Main pass" runs through every exercise in the lesson; getting one
45	// wrong adds it to wrongExercises and re-enqueues it at the end of the
46	// main queue. There's no fail state — Duolingo doesn't kick you out
47	// either, it just keeps cycling. If you genuinely can't get a question
48	// right, you can quit via the back button; we won't punish-restart.
49	//
50	// "Review pass" runs through the wrongExercises a second time as
51	// reinforcement. Same rules — wrong re-enqueues — so the user gets
52	// unlimited tries until each is correct.
53	type Phase =
54	  | { kind: "teach" }
55	  | { kind: "main-exercise"; index: number }
56	  | { kind: "main-feedback"; index: number; wasCorrect: boolean; exercise: Exercise }
57	  | { kind: "review-exercise"; index: number }
58	  | { kind: "review-feedback"; index: number; wasCorrect: boolean; exercise: Exercise }
59	  | { kind: "completed" };

63	  wrongExercises: Exercise[];              // dedupe'd list of exercises wrong
64	                                           // at least once during main pass —

  "old_string": "  // Reading lesson: short sentences using §9 vocab + a sprinkle of\n  // addhak (introduced in §11 properly — here it's just a \"double the\n  // consonant\" mark the teach screen flags). Teach-only; the lesson\n  // runner allows a teach screen with zero exercises.\n  out[\"mukta-reading\"] = {\n    id: \"mukta-reading\",\n    sectionId: \"s9\",\n    kind: \"teach-and-test\",\n    title: \"Mukta reading\",\n    curriculumRef: \"mukta-reading\",\n    exercises: [],\n  };\n\n  return out;\n}",
  "new_string": "  // Reading lesson: short sentences using §9 vocab + a sprinkle of\n  // addhak (introduced in §11 properly — here it's just a \"double the\n  // consonant\" mark the teach screen flags).\n  out[\"mukta-reading\"] = {\n    id: \"mukta-reading\",\n    sectionId: \"s9\",\n    kind: \"teach-and-test\",\n    title: \"Mukta reading\",\n    curriculumRef: \"mukta-reading\",\n    exercises: muktaReadingExercises(),\n  };\n\n  return out;\n}\n\n/**\n * For mukta-reading: one fill-in-blank + one assemble-translation per\n * sentence, paired so the learner reads the sentence both ways.\n * Distractor chips are drawn from the §9 vocab so the bank looks like\n * a coherent neighbourhood of words the learner has met.\n */\nfunction muktaReadingExercises(): Exercise[] {\n  const allWords = MUKTA_READING_SENTENCES.flatMap((s) => s.words.map((w) => w.pa));\n  const muktaVocab = MUKTA_LESSONS.flatMap((l) => l.words.map((w) => w.word));\n  const distractorVocab = [...new Set([...allWords, ...muktaVocab])];\n  const out: Exercise[] = [];\n\n  MUKTA_READING_SENTENCES.forEach((s, i) => {\n    // Fill-in-blank: pick the verb (last word before danda) to blank\n    // unless the sentence is only 2 words (then blank the noun).\n    const blankIdx = s.words.length >= 3 ? s.words.length - 1 : 0;\n    const answer = s.words[blankIdx].pa;\n    const template =\n      s.words.map((w, wi) => (wi === blankIdx ? \"___\" : w.pa)).join(\" \") + \"।\";\n    const fibId = `mukta-reading-${i}-fib`;\n    out.push({\n      id: fibId,\n      kind: \"fill-in-blank\",\n      template,\n      answers: [answer],\n      // Bank: the answer + 3 distractors from §9 vocab.\n      bank: [answer, ...distractorsFromPool(answer, distractorVocab, fibId, 3)],\n      englishGloss: s.en,\n      audioForSentence: s.pa,\n    });\n\n    // Assemble-translation: build the Punjabi sentence from English.\n    const asmId = `mukta-reading-${i}-asm`;\n    const correctOrder = s.words.map((w) => w.pa);\n    out.push({\n      id: asmId,\n      kind: \"assemble-translation\",\n      englishPrompt: s.en,\n      audioForSentence: s.pa,\n      correctOrder,\n      // Bank = correct words + 2 distractors from vocab so the learner\n      // can't just tap every chip in any order and pass.\n      bank: [\n        ...correctOrder,\n        ...distractorsFromPool(correctOrder[0], distractorVocab, asmId, 2)\n          .filter((w) => !correctOrder.includes(w)),\n      ],\n    });\n  });\n\n  return out;\n}"
}

  "old_string": "  // Reading lesson: short sentences using §9 vocab + a sprinkle of\n  // addhak (introduced in §11 properly — here it's just a \"double the\n  // consonant\" mark the teach screen flags).\n  out[\"mukta-reading\"] = {\n    id: \"mukta-reading\",\n    sectionId: \"s9\",\n    kind: \"teach-and-test\",\n    title: \"Mukta reading\",\n    curriculumRef: \"mukta-reading\",\n    exercises: muktaReadingExercises(),\n  };\n\n  return out;\n}\n\n/**\n * For mukta-reading: one fill-in-blank + one assemble-translation per\n * sentence, paired so the learner reads the sentence both ways.\n * Distractor chips are drawn from the §9 vocab so the bank looks like\n * a coherent neighbourhood of words the learner has met.\n */\nfunction muktaReadingExercises(): Exercise[] {\n  const allWords = MUKTA_READING_SENTENCES.flatMap((s) => s.words.map((w) => w.pa));\n  const muktaVocab = MUKTA_LESSONS.flatMap((l) => l.words.map((w) => w.word));\n  const distractorVocab = [...new Set([...allWords, ...muktaVocab])];\n  const out: Exercise[] = [];\n\n  MUKTA_READING_SENTENCES.forEach((s, i) => {\n    // Fill-in-blank: pick the verb (last word before danda) to blank\n    // unless the sentence is only 2 words (then blank the noun).\n    const blankIdx = s.words.length >= 3 ? s.words.length - 1 : 0;\n    const answer = s.words[blankIdx].pa;\n    const template =\n      s.words.map((w, wi) => (wi === blankIdx ? \"___\" : w.pa)).join(\" \") + \"।\";\n    const fibId = `mukta-reading-${i}-fib`;\n    out.push({\n      id: fibId,\n      kind: \"fill-in-blank\",\n      template,\n      answers: [answer],\n      // Bank: the answer + 3 distractors from §9 vocab.\n      bank: [answer, ...distractorsFromPool(answer, distractorVocab, fibId, 3)],\n      englishGloss: s.en,\n      audioForSentence: s.pa,\n    });\n\n    // Assemble-translation: build the Punjabi sentence from English.\n    const asmId = `mukta-reading-${i}-asm`;\n    const correctOrder = s.words.map((w) => w.pa);\n    out.push({\n      id: asmId,\n      kind: \"assemble-translation\",\n      englishPrompt: s.en,\n      audioForSentence: s.pa,\n      correctOrder,\n      // Bank = correct words + 2 distractors from vocab so the learner\n      // can't just tap every chip in any order and pass.\n      bank: [\n        ...correctOrder,\n        ...distractorsFromPool(correctOrder[0], distractorVocab, asmId, 2)\n          .filter((w) => !correctOrder.includes(w)),\n      ],\n    });\n  });\n\n  return out;\n}",
  "new_string": "  // Reading lessons: one lesson per sentence so each one stays short\n  // (teach screen for the single sentence + 3 quick exercises). The\n  // sentence list lives in MUKTA_READING_SENTENCES; lesson order tracks\n  // the list order so addhak appears gradually.\n  MUKTA_READING_SENTENCES.forEach((s, i) => {\n    const id = `mukta-reading-${i + 1}`;\n    out[id] = {\n      id,\n      sectionId: \"s9\",\n      kind: \"teach-and-test\",\n      // Title shows the English gloss so the user knows what they're\n      // about to read; the Punjabi is the work to do.\n      title: `Reading: ${s.en}`,\n      // Resolver looks up by index — see app/course/[lessonId]/page.tsx.\n      curriculumRef: `mukta-reading-${i}`,\n      exercises: singleSentenceExercises(s, id),\n    };\n  });\n\n  return out;\n}\n\n/**\n * Three exercises per sentence, escalating in difficulty:\n *   1. word-pick-meaning of the trickiest word (test single-word recall)\n *   2. fill-in-blank with that same word held out\n *   3. assemble-translation of the full sentence from English\n *\n * Distractor pool is the cumulative §9 vocab so the bank looks like a\n * coherent neighbourhood of words a learner has actually met.\n */\nfunction singleSentenceExercises(\n  sentence: typeof MUKTA_READING_SENTENCES[number],\n  lessonSlug: string,\n): Exercise[] {\n  const allReadingWords = MUKTA_READING_SENTENCES.flatMap((s) => s.words);\n  const muktaVocab = MUKTA_LESSONS.flatMap((l) =>\n    l.words.map((w) => ({ pa: w.word, en: w.meaning })),\n  );\n  const distractorWords = [...allReadingWords, ...muktaVocab];\n  const wordPool = [...new Set(distractorWords.map((w) => w.pa))];\n  const meaningPool = [...new Set(distractorWords.map((w) => w.en))];\n\n  // Word to drill: the last content word (often the verb) unless the\n  // sentence is a single token, in which case index 0.\n  const drillIdx = sentence.words.length > 1 ? sentence.words.length - 1 : 0;\n  const drill = sentence.words[drillIdx];\n\n  const out: Exercise[] = [];\n\n  // 1. Quick vocab check\n  const wpmId = `${lessonSlug}-wpm`;\n  out.push({\n    id: wpmId,\n    kind: \"word-pick-meaning\",\n    word: drill.pa,\n    correctMeaning: drill.en,\n    distractorMeanings: distractorsFromPool(drill.en, meaningPool, wpmId, 3),\n  });\n\n  // 2. Fill in the blank\n  const template =\n    sentence.words\n      .map((w, wi) => (wi === drillIdx ? \"___\" : w.pa))\n      .join(\" \") + \"।\";\n  const fibId = `${lessonSlug}-fib`;\n  out.push({\n    id: fibId,\n    kind: \"fill-in-blank\",\n    template,\n    answers: [drill.pa],\n    bank: [drill.pa, ...distractorsFromPool(drill.pa, wordPool, fibId, 3)],\n    englishGloss: sentence.en,\n    audioForSentence: sentence.pa,\n  });\n\n  // 3. Assemble translation\n  const asmId = `${lessonSlug}-asm`;\n  const correctOrder = sentence.words.map((w) => w.pa);\n  out.push({\n    id: asmId,\n    kind: \"assemble-translation\",\n    englishPrompt: sentence.en,\n    audioForSentence: sentence.pa,\n    correctOrder,\n    bank: [\n      ...correctOrder,\n      ...distractorsFromPool(correctOrder[0], wordPool, asmId, 2)\n        .filter((w) => !correctOrder.includes(w)),\n    ],\n  });\n\n  return out;\n}"
}
